# Twinkle Taskdesk

- Use Vite, React, and TypeScript.
- Keep the Twinkle brand palette anchored by `#fed550`, with charcoal, coral, mint, and warm off-white accents.
- Preserve the task request types and the existing conditional form behavior when extending the app.
- Keep GHL and email credentials server-side; the client should call configured webhook or API endpoints only.
- Run `npm run build` after implementation changes when dependencies are available.
